coastal.title: B.C.’s historic Little Red House destroyed by fire
coastal.description: The Langley Heritage Society said in an online post Friday that it was "sad and unfortunate" the home, also known as the McIver House, was never preserved.

coastal.title: Fire destroys Langley's beloved 'Little Red House'
coastal.description: A historic home popularly known as the Little Red House has been destroyed by fire after standing in the Township of Langley for almost 140 years.

kamloops.title: Gregor Robertson challenged on the Broadway Construction project
kamloops.description: Fable Diner and SportChek are just two of the most recent businesses to shutter along Broadway near Main Street as construction continues.

kamloops.title: A painful homecoming: Faulder residents return to see what the Bald range fire left behind
kamloops.description: Residents of Faulder were finally allowed to return to their properties, getting their first chance to walk through the areas hit by the Bald Range wildfire

kamloops.title: B.C. regional district lifts last of its evacuation orders for Ainslie Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: The Thompson-Nicola Regional District in southern British Columbia has lifted the last of its evacuation orders related to the out-of-control Ainslie Creek wildfire. The regional district says an order has been downgraded to an evacuation alert for 58 addressed properties in the Coldwater and Patchett Road areas.

kamloops.title: Severe drought conditions prompt new order limiting water use for irrigation in B.C. Interior
kamloops.description: A new water-restriction order has been placed on the Bessette Creek area in the southern Interior of British Columbia, after the province deemed chinook salmon at risk from drought conditions.

kamloops.title: Federal government to match Red Cross donations for Summerland wildfire recovery
kamloops.description: The federal government says it will match donations made to the Red Cross for wildfire recovery efforts in Summerland.

kamloops.title: Some Indigenous businesses are trying to avoid U.S. markets amid trade war
kamloops.description: Some Indigenous businesses in Canada are avoiding selling products to the U.S. in order to avoid uncertainty and hassle.

cariboo.title: Summerland wildfire that forced thousands out of homes now being held
cariboo.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service says the blaze is expected to remain within its current perimeter of about 252 square kilometres west of Summerland.

all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. The drug, called glutathione, is marketed to fire fighters to remove toxins, but the IAFF says there are no scientific studies […]

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. Research led by Boise State University PhD student Kendra Fallon, now a National Fire Ecologist […]

all.title: Subway restaurant owner in Quesnel fined for trying to suppress worker injury claim: WorkSafeBC
all.description: The owner of a Subway restaurant in Quesnel, B.C., was fined $2,500 after WorkSafeBC found they tried to get a worker to retract their injury claim after being burned on the job.

all.title: Junior hockey players in Western Canada, Ontario can seek compensation for alleged abuse, court says
all.description: The Ontario Superior Court of Justice has approved an opt-in process for current and former players in the Ontario Hockey League and Western Hockey League who allege they were victims of abuse or hazing.
